title: Ay baba dekhte rehna
body:
sakina kehti jaati thi sar e shabbir se ro kar
bithaata hai mujhe shimr e sitamgar pushte naaqa par
ay baba dekhte rehna
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke waaste rakhna nazar mujhpar mere baba
na jaane kyun sataata hai ye mujhko darr mere baba
kahin aisa na ho ke raah mein mar jaun mai gir kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nazdeek se shimr e sitamgar jab guzarta hai
yateemi par khuda jaane meri kyun tanz karta hai
kahin aisa na ho rakh de gulu e khusk par khanjar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm khaaya na meri kamsini par baani e shar ne
shutar ki pusht se baandha hai ay baba sitamgar ne
mai sar se paon tak odhe huwe hoon zakhmon ki chadar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon ke aage aap ka chehra rahe baba
mujhe dedaar dauraane safar hota rahe baba
har ek sadma saha karlungi lekin mujhko mud mud kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai saabir baap ki beti hoon dunya ko bataungi
mujhe jis haal mein le jayenge aada mai jaungi
na aayega kisi bhi mod par shikwa mere lab par
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha abbas ka sar kyun nazar aate nahi mujhko
mai kab se dhoondti hoon par nazar aata nahi mujhko
teher jaaye to batlana sar e naiza chacha ka sar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri kismat ne ay baba ye kaise din dikhaye hai
khuda jaane ke ab tak kitne pathar maine khaaye hai
mai roti hoon to ghurbat par meri haste hai ahle shar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laga rakhi hai ay baba mere rone pe pabandi
bata sakti nahi jo kaifiyat is waqt hai meri
musalsal khaa rahi hoon pusht par kode kabhi pathar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
karun mai daastan e ranj o gham asif bayan kaise
sunaye ahle emaan ko sakina ki fughan kaise
sada ye aaj bhi ay shadman aati hai reh reh kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
author: Asif Bijnori
